fact: The minister told the Council of Ministers on 6 March 2019 that the national ICT development policy (politique nationale de développement des TIC) was elaborated by the government between 2008 and 2009, and that the electronic transactions bill fits within it.
title: Congo : Conseil des ministres du mercredi 6 mars 2019
publisher: Ministère des Postes, des Télécommunications et de l'Économie numérique
